verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair automation question for a SaaS finance platform, but nothing in the evidence shows user-configurable recurring jobs or workflow scheduling. Digits does automate work continuously: real-time auto-booking, 24/7 bookkeeping and an always-on close workflow. The "schedules" it generates are accounting depreciation and accrual schedules, not job scheduling. Webhooks and a read-only MCP server provide no scheduler either.
